- **Class B Misdemeanor**: If the offense is under § 33.02(a) without aggravating factors, it is classified as a Class B misdemeanor (§ 33.02(b)).
- **State Jail Felony**: If the defendant has two or more prior convictions under this chapter, or if the computer system accessed is owned by the government or a critical infrastructure facility, it escalates to a state jail felony (§ 33.02(b)).
- **Class C Misdemeanor**: If the aggregate amount involved is less than $100, it is a Class C misdemeanor (§ 33.02(b-2)(1)).
- **Class A Misdemeanor**: If the aggregate amount involved is $750 or more but less than $2,500, it is a Class A misdemeanor (§ 33.02(b-2)(3)).
- **Felony of the First Degree**: If the aggregate amount involved is $300,000 or more, or if the actor accesses more than one computer system to obtain identifying information, it is a felony of the first degree (§ 33.02(b-2)(7)).
